environment.description: Same FastAPI container deployed on a Kubernetes pod with a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's kubelet `--seccomp-profile-root` directory. The profile (referenced as `localhost/microservice-hardened.json`) uses a whitelist approach with defaultAction SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. The allowed syscall set includes read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, ioctl, access, getpid, clone3, futex, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, accept4, bind, listen, recvfrom, sendto, setsockopt, getsockname — but explicitly OMITS execve, execveat, ptrace, and fork/vfork. The container also runs with `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` with only /data/processed mounted as a PVC (mode 0755, noexec). A separate emptyDir volume is mounted at /tmp with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 10Mi, but the noexec mount option is applied via a PodSecurityPolicy annotation (`seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/allowedProfiles: localhost/microservice-hardened.json`). Note: the seccomp profile was last audited 2024-01-15 and the allowlist was generated via strace profiling of the Python uvicorn worker during normal operation.
